spec.rawSql:
WITH target_instrument AS (
  SELECT id, name
  FROM instruments
  WHERE id IN ($instrument)
)

SELECT
  o.start_time AS time,
  o.end_time AS timeEnd,
  t.name || ' OFF' AS title,
  'TEM server offline' AS text
FROM em_off o
JOIN target_instrument t
  ON o.instrument_id = t.id

WITH target_param AS (
  SELECT
    param_id
  FROM
    parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'HTTank'
    AND param_name = 'HTTankSettingVoltage'
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num,
    LAG(d.value_num) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        d.time
    ) AS prev_value
  FROM
    data d
    JOIN target_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),
events AS (
  SELECT
    time AS annotation_time,
    value_num AS new_value
  FROM
    changes
  WHERE
    prev_value IS DISTINCT
  FROM
    value_num
)
SELECT
  annotation_time AS time,
  annotation_time + INTERVAL '1 hour' AS timeEnd,
  'HT changed' AS title,
  'New value: ' || new_value / 1000 || 'kV' AS text
FROM
  events

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM tem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGPcoPressure'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM tem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGPcoPressure'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'IGPcl'
    AND param_name IN ('IGPclOnTime', 'IGPclLeadTime', 'IGPclTotalLifetime', 'IGPclOperationalLifetime')
),

last_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.param_id)
    d.param_id,
    d.value_num,
    d.time
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  ORDER BY d.param_id, d.time DESC
)

SELECT
  p.param_name,
  l.value_num,
  l.time
FROM last_values l
JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = l.param_id

WITH counter_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'IGPco'
    AND param_name IN ('IGPcoOnTime', 'IGPcoLeadTime', 'IGPcoTotalLifetime', 'IGPcoOperationalLifetime')
),

last_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.param_id)
    d.param_id,
    d.value_num,
    d.time
  FROM data d
  JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  ORDER BY d.param_id, d.time DESC
)

SELECT
  p.param_name,
  l.value_num,
  l.time
FROM last_values l
JOIN counter_param p ON p.param_id = l.param_id

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND subsystem IN ('HalOpticsBrick', 'HalTemOpticsBrick')
    AND component IN ('Lens temperatures', 'LensTemperatures')
    AND param_name LIKE '%emperature'
)
SELECT
    time_bucket_gapfill('1 hour', d.time) AS time,
    p.param_name,
    locf(approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(d.value_num)) - 273.15) AS median_1h
FROM data d
JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'IGPco'
    AND param_name = 'IGPcoState'
),

enums AS (
  SELECT e.enum_id, e.member_name, e.value
  FROM enum_values e
  JOIN state_param p ON p.enum_id = e.enum_id
)

SELECT
  e.member_name AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
JOIN enums e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  AND e.value = d.value_num
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY e.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC

SELECT
        start_time,
        end_time,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(end_time - start_time)) AS total_duration
    FROM tem_cryocycle_daily,
        state_periods(agg, 1) -- boolean = 1 states
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND param_name = 'Column'
      AND $__timeFilter(day)

WITH matching_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'TempCtrl'
    AND param_name = 'Lcldwr'
),

bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    time_bucket('30 seconds', d.time) AS bucket,
    AVG(d.value_num) AS avg_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN matching_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  GROUP BY bucket
),

lagged AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    avg_value,
    LAG(avg_value, 1) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_1,
    LAG(avg_value, 2) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_2,
    LAG(avg_value, 3) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS val_3
  FROM bucketed
),

labeled AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN avg_value > 90 AND (val_1 < 90 OR val_1 IS NULL) THEN true
      WHEN avg_value >= COALESCE(val_1, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_2, -1e9)
       AND avg_value >= COALESCE(val_3, -1e9)
       AND avg_value > 90 THEN true
      ELSE false
    END AS is_peak
  FROM lagged
),

with_peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN is_peak AND NOT LAG(is_peak, 1, false) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS new_peak_start
  FROM labeled
),

peak_groups AS (
  SELECT *,
    SUM(new_peak_start) OVER (ORDER BY bucket) AS peak_group_id
  FROM with_peak_groups
),

ranked_peaks AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS time,
    avg_value,
    peak_group_id,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY peak_group_id ORDER BY avg_value DESC) AS val_rank
  FROM peak_groups
  WHERE is_peak
),

collapsed_peaks AS (
  SELECT time
  FROM ranked_peaks
  WHERE val_rank = 1
),

with_deltas AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time
  FROM collapsed_peaks
),

deltas AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (time - prev_time)) AS sec_between
  FROM with_deltas
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT AVG(sec_between) AS avg_sec_between_refills
FROM deltas;

-- 1. Try to get VbfpvState param
WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND param_name = 'VbfpvState'
    AND subsystem = 'MdlVacuumBrick'
),

has_state AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS exists FROM state_param
),

-- 2. Get value for VALVE_OPENED or Open
running_enum AS (
  SELECT p.param_id, e.value AS running_value
  FROM state_param p
  JOIN enum_values e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  WHERE e.member_name IN ('VALVE_OPENED', 'Open')
),

-- 3a. Use VbfpvState-based transitions if available
state_data AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num AS acquisition_state,
    CASE WHEN d.value_num = r.running_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_running
  FROM data d
  JOIN running_enum r ON d.param_id = r.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

transitions AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    is_running,
    LAG(is_running) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_running
  FROM state_data
),

start_events AS (
  SELECT time AS start_time
  FROM transitions
  WHERE is_running = 1 AND (prev_running IS NULL OR prev_running = 0)
),

end_events AS (
  SELECT time AS end_time
  FROM transitions
  WHERE is_running = 0 AND prev_running = 1
),

vbfpv_segments AS (
  SELECT s.start_time, MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
  FROM start_events s
  JOIN end_events e ON e.end_time > s.start_time
  GROUP BY s.start_time
),

-- 3b. Fallback: detect PIRbfPressure decreasing
pressure_param AS (
  SELECT param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument AND param_name = 'PIRbfPressure'
  LIMIT 1
),

pressure_data AS (
  SELECT
    d.time,
    d.value_num,
    LAG(d.value_num) OVER (ORDER BY d.time) AS prev_value
  FROM data d
  JOIN pressure_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
  WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
),

pressure_transitions AS (
  SELECT
    time,
    CASE WHEN value_num < prev_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_decreasing,
    LAG(CASE WHEN value_num < prev_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_decreasing
  FROM pressure_data
),

pressure_starts AS (
  SELECT time AS start_time
  FROM pressure_transitions
  WHERE is_decreasing = 1 AND (prev_decreasing = 0 OR prev_decreasing IS NULL)
),

pressure_ends AS (
  SELECT time AS end_time
  FROM pressure_transitions
  WHERE is_decreasing = 0 AND prev_decreasing = 1
),

pressure_segments AS (
  SELECT s.start_time, MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
  FROM pressure_starts s
  JOIN pressure_ends e ON e.end_time > s.start_time
  GROUP BY s.start_time
),

-- 4. Use vbfpv_segments if param exists, otherwise fallback
final_segments AS (
  SELECT * FROM vbfpv_segments WHERE (SELECT exists FROM has_state)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM pressure_segments WHERE NOT (SELECT exists FROM has_state)
),

segment_with_durations AS (
  SELECT
    start_time,
    end_time,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM end_time - start_time) AS duration_sec,
    LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_start
  FROM final_segments
)

SELECT
  AVG(duration_sec) AS "Avg duration",
  AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_start - end_time)) AS "Avg time between cycles"
FROM segment_with_durations
WHERE next_start IS NOT NULL;

spec.title: Firmware errors
spec.description: Count events when the firmware was in Off/Error/Unknown state

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.param_name AS "Board",
  COUNT(*) AS "Errors",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last error"
FROM data d
JOIN parameters p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
JOIN enum_values e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND p.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND p.subsystem = 'HalTemOpticsBrick'
  AND p.component = 'Firmware states'
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND e.member_name IN ('Error', 'Unknown', 'Off')
  AND d.value_num = e.value
GROUP BY p.param_name
ORDER BY MAX(d.time) DESC;

SELECT
  p.param_name AS "Board",
  COUNT(*) AS "Offline events",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last event"
FROM data d
JOIN parameters p
  ON p.param_id = d.param_id
JOIN enum_values e
  ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND p.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND p.subsystem IN ('HalTemOpticsBrick', 'HalOpticsBrick')
  AND (
        p.component = 'Operational states'
        OR (p.component = 'Optics' AND p.param_name = 'Optics_OperationalState')
      )
  AND e.member_name = 'Up'
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num != e.value
GROUP BY p.param_name
ORDER BY MAX(d.time) DESC;

WITH target_params AS (
  SELECT param_id, param_name, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component IN ('TMP', 'TMPm', 'TMPp')
    AND param_name IN ('TMPError', 'TMPmError', 'TMPpError')
)

SELECT
  p.param_name AS "Pump",
  COUNT(*) AS "Errors",
  MAX(d.time) AS "Last error"
FROM data d
JOIN target_params p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num != 0
GROUP BY p.param_name
ORDER BY MAX(d.time) DESC

SELECT
  hour AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "1-hour average"
FROM tem_pressure_hourly
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGPclPressure'
  AND $__timeFilter(hour)
ORDER BY hour

SELECT
  day AS time,
  param_name,
  mean_value AS "24-hour average"
FROM tem_pressure_daily
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_name = 'IGPclPressure'
  AND $__timeFilter(day)
ORDER BY day

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND subsystem IN ('HalOpticsBrick', 'HalTemOpticsBrick')
    AND component IN ('Lens temperatures', 'LensTemperatures')
    AND param_name LIKE '%emperature'
)

  SELECT
    time_bucket_gapfill('24 hour', d.time) AS time,
    p.param_name,
    approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(d.value_num)) - 273.15 AS median_24h
  FROM data d
  JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
  WHERE
    d.instrument_id = $instrument
    AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
    AND d.value_num > 0
  GROUP BY 1,2
  ORDER BY 1

WITH param_ids AS (
  SELECT
    param_name,
    param_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE
    instrument_id = $instrument
    AND subsystem IN ('HalOpticsBrick', 'HalTemOpticsBrick')
    AND component IN ('Lens temperatures', 'LensTemperatures')
    AND param_name LIKE '%emperature'
)

SELECT
  time_bucket('12 hours', d.time) AS time,
  p.param_name,
  MAX(d.value_num - 273.15) - MIN(d.value_num - 273.15) AS stability_12h
FROM data d
JOIN param_ids p ON p.param_id = d.param_id
WHERE
  d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num > 0  -- filter out invalid readings
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1;

WITH state_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'IGPcl'
    AND param_name = 'IGPclState'
),

enums AS (
  SELECT e.enum_id, e.member_name, e.value
  FROM enum_values e
  JOIN state_param p ON p.enum_id = e.enum_id
)

SELECT
  e.member_name AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Count"
FROM data d
JOIN state_param p ON d.param_id = p.param_id
JOIN enums e ON e.enum_id = p.enum_id
  AND e.value = d.value_num
WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
GROUP BY e.member_name
ORDER BY "Count" DESC
